title: Taco Taxi Trouble
style: Comedy cumbia-pop with a bouncy dembow swing, handclaps, güiro chatter, and bright brass stabs; verse stays cheeky and conversational, pre-chorus speeds up with rising ad-libs, chorus lands on a chanty hook with gang vocals, and the bridge cuts to near-silence for a punchline reset. Playful lead vocal with tight doubles, little shouted asides, delay throws on joke words, and rim-shot accents between lines. Crisp, colorful mix with a sunny, cartoon-bright finish., comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I crossed the border with one clean plan
Find a taco so big it would need a van
I said “hola” and I meant “let’s go”
Then my map said “friend, you still don’t know”

I asked for directions, they said “just one block”
I took three turns and a rooster clocked
The taxi driver laughed, said “you are bold”
Then he charged me extra for being lost and cold

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh no, not again
I’m in deep
The menu’s in Spanish
And I can’t just keep

[Chorus]
Ay, ay, ay, I’m in Mexico
I came for the food and I’m moving slow
Ay, ay, ay, don’t ask me why
One bite, one laugh, and I’m saying “sí” tonight

Ay, ay, ay, I’m in Mexico
My drink got a lime and a little too much glow
Ay, ay, ay, here we go
I lost my keys but I found the show

[Verse 2]
There was a mariachi near the market stand
Serenading my shoelace, that was unplanned
I tried to dance like I had the skill
But my hips said “sir, we’re standing still”

The vendor saw me, gave me that grin
Put salsa on my shirt and called that a win
I wore the stain like a badge of pride
Now every photo looks professionally fried

[Pre-Chorus]
Oh no, not again
I’m in deep
The whole town’s watching
And I’m trying to keep

[Chorus]
Ay, ay, ay, I’m in Mexico
I came for the food and I’m moving slow
Ay, ay, ay, don’t ask me why
One bite, one laugh, and I’m saying “sí” tonight

Ay, ay, ay, I’m in Mexico
My drink got a lime and a little too much glow
Ay, ay, ay, here we go
I lost my keys but I found the show

[Bridge]
I asked for “mild”
They gave me fire
I said “one taco”
They brought a choir

I’m not upset
I’m impressed
I came for a visit
Left as a mess

[Final Chorus]
Ay, ay, ay, I’m in Mexico
I came for the food and I’m moving slow
Ay, ay, ay, don’t ask me why
One bite, one laugh, and I’m saying “sí” tonight

Ay, ay, ay, I’m in Mexico
My heart went dance, my shoes said “no”
Ay, ay, ay, here we go
I lost my plans but I love this show
